title: Search its sources
summary: Searches this agent's sources for items on a topic. With no source named it searches all of them at once and returns one list, ranked by how well each item matches the words; the person then chooses by number.
whenToUse: Use first when the person wants papers, studies, articles, posts or news on a topic. Name one source only when the person did.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: Search words, such as 'on-device language models iPhone'

arguments.name: source
arguments.description: One source, only when the person named it, such as pubmed. Use all, or leave it empty, to search every source this agent has.

example: Go get me a bunch of recent AI research papers about small language models
_note: Phase AV.0: the id stays `searchPapers` so the packs and the tool name the planner learned keep working; the source is now an argument, not a fact in Swift (the AG.2 verb searched arXiv only). Phase AV.10 (2026-11-10): no source named means every source at once, merged and ranked.
